notes: *of tapestry* was kept inside מַרְבַדִּים's own rendering as a substantive rendered by a multi-word phrase (rule 31); treating it as supplied English was the competing reading.

The first *with* reaches the verb's second bare accusative and joins רָבַדְתִּי's unit (rule 44); the second *With* stands in a gapped line with no written preposition anywhere in the verse, so it is the bare nominal's under rule 33.
The margin's *Or, cushions* was read and set aside (rule 38).
